reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on their new #central-team message to confirm the correction: Marrow Agrisupply's new inbound lane is at Gate 47, not Dock 23. They said no action was needed, so I didn't change anything.

I didn't save the site to memory the first time, so there was no old note to fix. Pree's correction in the channel is now the record, and it replaces their Dock 23 post from this morning.
